key.name: toggle-history
key.summary: Open the clipboard history

key.name: toggle-notes
key.summary: Open the notes and accounts section

key.name: generate-password
key.summary: Generate a password and paste it into the focused field

key.name: free-super-v
key.summary: Remove our shortcuts from GNOME's notification list shortcut

key.name: removed-message-tray-bindings
key.summary: Shortcuts removed from toggle-message-tray, restored on disable

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste automatically when an item is selected

key.name: paste-keys
key.summary: Key combination simulated to paste text

key.name: popup-position
key.summary: Where the popup appears
key.description: caret: below the text cursor of the focused field, falling back to the mouse pointer when the application does not report it. pointer: next to the mouse pointer. center: center of the screen.

key.name: popup-width
key.summary: Popup width in pixels

key.name: popup-height
key.summary: Popup height in pixels

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.summary: Show an icon in the top bar

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned items

key.name: preview-lines
key.summary: Lines of text shown per history item
key.description: Longer items are cut with an ellipsis (…). Long lines that wrap count as several lines.

key.name: save-history
key.summary: Keep the history across sessions

key.name: save-images
key.summary: Also record copied images

key.name: max-image-size
key.summary: Maximum image size in MiB

key.name: ignore-sensitive
key.summary: Ignore content that password managers mark as secret

key.name: private-mode
key.summary: Private mode: record nothing while enabled

key.name: password-length
key.summary: Length of generated passwords

key.name: password-uppercase
key.summary: Include uppercase letters (A–Z)

key.name: password-lowercase
key.summary: Include lowercase letters (a–z)

key.name: password-digits
key.summary: Include digits (0–9)

key.name: password-symbols
key.summary: Include symbols

key.name: password-symbol-set
key.summary: Symbols that generated passwords may contain

key.name: password-exclude-ambiguous
key.summary: Avoid look-alike characters such as 0/O and 1/l/I

key.name: clear-secret-seconds
key.summary: Clear a copied password from the clipboard after N seconds (0 = never)
